assessments.reasoning: The terms used to refer to respondents and to relationships within the household appear directly in the wording of the questions and response options of the questionnaire. Respondents are referred to as 'cada una de las personas que residen en este hogar', 'usted', or with gendered slashes/parentheses ('afiliada(o)'). Household headship and relationship options use gender-inclusive binary pairs or combined male/female terms ('jefa o jefe del hogar', 'ESPOSA/O O CONVIVIENTE O CONCUBINA(O)', 'HIJA O HIJO', 'HIJASTRA O HIJASTRO', 'NUERA O YERNO', 'NIETA O NIETO', 'HERMANA O HERMANO', 'CUÑADA O CUÑADO', 'MADRE O PADRE', 'SUEGRA O SUEGRO', 'ABUELA O ABUELO', 'TRABAJADOR(A) DEL HOGAR'). Marital status uses gendered slash options ('SOLTERA/O', 'CASADA/O', 'CONVIVIENTE O CONCUBINA/O', 'SEPARADA/O', 'DIVORCIADA/O', 'VIUDA/O').
